entry.title: AI-Forward Marketing Teams Are Hiring More, Not Less, Survey Data Shows
entry.summary: AI adoption in marketing is correlating with team growth, not broad headcount cuts, according to new survey data from Exploding Topics. Its survey of more than 1,000 marketing budget decision-makers found that 60.12% of marketing teams expanded headcount over the previous 12 months, while 8.9% reduced it.
